desc.en: Ziyarat of Imam Zadah Mohsin Ibnul Husain (a).
desc.urdu: امام زادہ محسن ابن الحسینؑ کی زیارت۔

desc.en: Raas-ul-Husain (a): Ziyarat of the blessed head of Imam Husain (a)…
desc.rurdu: Raas-ul-Husain (a): Imam Husain (a) ke sar-e-aqdas ki ziyarat…
desc.urdu: راس الحسینؑ: امام حسین ؑ کے سرِ مبارک کی زیارت۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکَ یَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکَ یَابْنَ اَمِیْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکَ یَابْنَ الصِّدِّیْقَۃِ الطَّاہِرَۃِ سَیِّدَۃِ نِسَآئِ الْعَالَمِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْکَ یَا مَوْلَایَ یَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اللہِ وَرَحْمَۃُ اللہِ وَبَرَکَاتُہٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YABNA RASOOLILLAAH ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YABNA AMEERIL MO’MENEENA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YABNAS SIDDEEQATIT TAAHERATE SAYYEDATE NESAAA-IL A’ALAMEENA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YAA MAWLAAYA YAA ABA A’BDILLAAHE WA RAHMATULLAAHE WA BARAKAATOHU.

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger. Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful. Peace be upon you, O son of the veracious, immaculate lady Fatimah the Doyenne of the women of the world. Peace be upon you, O my master Abu Abdullah. So be upon you Allah’s mercy and blessings.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَشْہَدُ اَنَّکَ قَدْ اَقَمْتَ الصَّلٰوۃَ وَاٰتَیْتَ الزَّکٰوۃَ وَاَمَرْتَ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَنَہَیْتَ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَتَلَوْتَ الْکِتَابَ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِہٖ وَجَاہَدْتَ فِیْ اللہِ حَقَّ جِہَادِہٖ وَصَبَرْتَ عَلَی الْاَذٰی فِیْ جَنْبِہٖ مُحْتَبِسًا حَتّٰی اَتٰیکَ الْیَقِیْنُ۔

lines.rarabic: ASH-HADO ANNAKA QAD AQAMTAS SALAATA WA AATAYTAZ ZAKAATA WA AMARTA BIL MA’ROOFE WA NAHAYTA A’NIL MUNKARE WA TALAWTAL KETAABA HAQQA TELAAWATEHI WA JAAHAD-TA FILLAAHE HAQQA JEHAADEHI WA SABARTA A’LAL AZAA FEE JAMBEHI MOHTASEBAN HATTAA ATAAKAL YAQEEN.

trans.en: I bear witness that you performed the prayers, defrayed the poor-rate, enjoined the right, forbade the wrong, recited the Book (ie. the Holy Qur’an) as exactly as it should be recited, strove for the sake of Allah as exactly as striving must be, and faced all troubles steadfastly for His sake, seeking his reward, until death came upon you.

arabic.text: وَاَشْہَدُ اَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ خَالَفُوْکَ وَحَارَبُوْکَ وَاَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ خَذَلُوْکَ وَالَّذِیْنَ قَتَلُوْکَ مَلْعُوْنُوْنَ عَلٰی لِسَانِ النَّبِیِّ الْاُمِّیِّ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ افْتَرٰی لَعَنَ اللہُ الظَّالِمِیْنَ لَکُمْ مِنَ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ وَالْاٰخِرِیْنَ وَضَاعَفَ عَلَیْہِمُ الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِیْمَ۔

lines.rarabic: WA ASH-HADO ANNAL LAZEENA KHAALAFOOKA WA HAARABOOKA WA ANNAL LAZEENA KHAZALOOKA WALLAZEENA QATALOOKA MAL-O’ONOONA A’LAA LESAANIN NABIYYIL UMMIYYE WA QAD KHAABA MANIF TARAA LA-A’NALLAAHUZ ZAALEMEENA LAKUM MENAL AWWALEENA WAL AAKHEREENA WA ZAA-A’FA A’LAYHEMUL A’ZAABAL ALEEM.

trans.en: I also bear witness that those who dissented you, those who fought against you, those who let you down, and those who slew you (all those) were accursed directly by the Meccan Prophet. And he who forges lies indeed fails to attain his desire. May Allah curse those who wronged you from amongst the past and the present generations. May Allah also double for them the painful torment.

arabic.text: اَتَیْتُکَ یَا مَوْلَایَ یَابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ زَآئِرًا عَارِفًا بِحَقِّکَ مُوَالِیًا لِاَوْلِیَائِکَ مُعَادِیًا لِاَعْدَآئِکَ مُسْتَبْصِرًا بِالْہُدَی الَّذِیْ اَنْتَ عَلَیْہِ عَارِفًا بِضَلَالَۃِ مَنْ خَالَفَکَ فَاشْفَعْ لِیْ عِنْدَ رَبِّکَ۔

lines.rarabic: ATAYTOKA YAA MAWLAAYA YABNA RASOOLILLAAH ZAAA-ERAN A’AREFAN BE HAQQEKA MOWAALEYAN LE AWLEYAA-EKA MO-A’ADEYAN LE A-A’DAAA-EKA MUSTABSERAN BIL HODAL LAZEE ANTA A’LAYHE A’AREFAN BE ZALAALATE MAN KHAALAFAKA FASH-FA’ LEE I’NDA RABBEK.

trans.en: O my master and son of Allah’s Messenger, I have come to you visiting you, acknowledging the standing that you enjoy, declaring my loyalty to those who are loyal to you, renouncing your enemies, seeking to follow the true guidance that you are following, and recognizing the deviation of those who oppose you; so, (please) intercede for me before your Lord.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.en: Then recite 2 rakats Namaz-e-Ziyarat like Fajr namaz.
desc.rurdu: Phir 2 rakat Namaz-e-Ziyarat, Fajr namaz ki tarah padhe.
desc.urdu: پھر ۲ رکعت نماز زیارت (نماز فجر کی طرح) پڑھے۔
